test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The marked price of an item was ₹12,500. Two successive discounts of 12% each was offered on its sale. What was the selling price (in ₹) of the item?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹12,500

Discount 1 = 12%

Discount 2 = 12%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) after successive discounts = MP × (1 - D1/100) × (1 - D2/100)

**Calculations:**

SP = 12,500 × (1 - 12/100) × (1 - 12/100)

⇒ SP = 12,500 × 0.88 × 0.88

⇒ SP = 12,500 × 0.7744

⇒ SP = 9680

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
